known_gray_zone.note: Eviction drops samples whose timestamp is exactly at the horizon (`_samples[0][0] <= horizon`, i.e. now - t == window_seconds), yet the class docstring says a sample is retained while `now - t <= window`; code and docstring disagree at the exact window boundary. A reviewer could reasonably flag this inconsistency, but it is pre-existing and not one of the injected defects.
